name: AAOS 2027 Annual Meeting
description: The AAOS Annual Meeting is the flagship educational and networking meeting of the American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons for orthopedic surgeons. The 2027 edition takes place at the Venetian Convention and Expo Center in Las Vegas, Nevada.
